# Retention manifest

`manifest.json` records the exact bytes of the pre-campaign research repository
at `a712fbec69bd03b10c20d8078b478c38734d9c02`, excluding only the editable README
and gitignore. Files remain at their original paths; they are not copied here.
The 289 native ALGAL run receipts and all other recorded artifacts must remain
available and unchanged. See [the evidence index](../../../docs/legacy-evidence.md)
for gaps in source availability and native toolchain qualification.

This is a historical retention manifest, not a new study's fixture data or a
publication/rights-clearance manifest. Do not regenerate it after a check fails.
